remarks: Introducing a BRAND NEW 2-storey home in the desirable community of Dansereau Meadows in Beaumont, built by Anthem. This beautifully designed home offers 5 BEDROOMS, including a BEDROOM and FULL BATHROOM on the main floor, plus 4 bedrooms upstairs. The open-concept main floor features a bright living room, spacious dining area and a stunning kitchen with cabinets to the ceiling, quartz countertops, upgraded kitchen sink, chimney-style hood fan, gas line to range, stainless steel appliances and a convenient walk-through pantry. Modern upgrades include black plumbing fixtures, upgraded black lighting and railing on the main floor. The primary ensuite features an upgraded tiled shower. A SIDE ENTRY, 9' FOUNDATION and suite rough-in plumbing offer excellent future development potential. Complete with a FRONT DOUBLE ATTACHED GARAGE. *Home is under construction. *Photos are from a previous build and for illustration only. *Actual finishes and upgrades may vary. (id:67522)
